summary: RFC 2648 defined the "ietf" URN namespace and some sub-namespaces, and RFC 3553 added "params" with its own registry. No single place listed every sub-namespace under "ietf". This document creates and fills such a registry, changing how new sub-namespaces are added.

eli5.summary: A big list of names was scattered around. This makes one tidy list of every sub-name under "ietf" so nothing gets lost.

questions: second level urn namespaces under ietf
